slides.h: For when your brain is [[completely fried]]: 5 comedies with zero plot to track.
slides.dek: No lore. No stakes. Just gags and good company.

slides.title: Nichijou
slides.why: Ordinary school life animated like an action blockbuster. The best overreactions in the medium.

slides.title: KonoSuba
slides.why: An adventuring party where every member is the worst, and it never stops being funny.

slides.title: The Way of the Househusband
slides.why: A retired yakuza legend attacks housework with terrifying intensity. Episodes are minutes long.

slides.title: Grand Blue
slides.why: A diving club, questionable decisions, and university chaos at full volume.

slides.title: Daily Lives of High School Boys
slides.why: Sketch comedy about boys being profoundly, lovingly dumb. Watch any episode in any order.

slides.h: What do you watch on [[empty brain]] nights?
slides.body: Drop it below. Save this for the next long day.
